_status: Second real Screen Registry entry. Added 2026-09-07 after three visual deviations on B10-58669 (B10-59822/59823/59826) survived a Phase 5 pass that was performed by eye instead of through the deterministic engine. expectedComponents are AUTHORED from the design frames of Figma node 3302-1538 (file kmIp6MpoxXBKf3wJ1P6wkR, 'Closing Branch Hours'); figmaFileKey/figmaNodeId stay PLACEHOLDER per ADR-003 Decision 2 and are resolved at execution from the story's Figma URL.
_identity_convention: componentId matches the testId synthesized by automation/visual/dump_web_screen.js: '<role>:<slug of a STABLE label>' — an aria-label, a name/id/formcontrolname/placeholder attribute, the label of the control's row, or (for unnamed painted chrome) its first class token. Repeats get an ordinal suffix, so the two selects in a day row are 'combobox:sunday' (From) and 'combobox:sunday-2' (To). Identity never comes from a control's current VALUE, which changes.
_known_engine_gap: L2 flags expected components that are MISSING or duplicated. It does not flag components the build renders that the design does not — so the picker's ISO week-number column (td.week cells, rendered as text:36 … text:41) is NOT catchable deterministically today. It needs an 'unexpected component' check on screens marked exhaustively specified. Recorded rather than worked around.
